description: The pie chart presents the distribution of emotion categories in the context of the paper “Evaluation of Speaker Anonymization on Emotional Speech,” showing 6 slices in total: Frustration (teal/blue-green) at approximately 25.1%, Neutral (purple) at approximately 23.1%, Anger (olive/greenish) at approximately 14.9%, Sadness (tan/light brown) at approximately 14.7%, Excitement (reddish) at approximately 14.1%, and Happiness (blue) at approximately 8.1%. Percentage values are printed inside the slices, and the category names are placed around the pie without a separate legend; no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the slice sizes do not appear strictly ordered by magnitude.
